_comment: Data classification per tab and view (core-009). Version 1 is labels only: nothing here changes access, which core-007 (roles.json) still decides. The values are placeholders that mirror today's access, for Meghna to set (core-009 open item 1). Levels run lowest to highest. Every tab or view the web app shows needs a key here, and every role in roles.json needs a clearance; the tests check both.

levels.label: Public
levels.description: Can be shared outside the company.

levels.label: Proprietary
levels.description: Internal business information; not for outside parties.

levels.label: Confidential
levels.description: Detailed data and its sources; for the people who work with it.

levels.label: Sensitive
levels.description: The most restricted data; strictly need to know.
